## Authority and release boundaries

The test bridge must be cfg(test) within the private verifier seal, derive arrays/events from raw declarations and instructions through the same prepare and validate continuation, then synchronously call the real native consumer. No witness, raw/declaration/plan authority, callbacks or caller-trusted summary may escape. Outputs are bounded LLVM/diagnostics and inert counters. Production carrier/opcode gates and source closure remain unconditional. No synthetic records/FieldIds, parallel array executor or source fallback.

## Requirement -> minimum evidence

1. Signed bounds and fuel dominate index conversion, offset multiplication, reference-pointer load, byte GEP and element load/store. Inspect actual real LLVM CFG/dominance and verify with LLVM19.1.7; observe source-free ELF negative/upper/extreme/N0 failures. Preserve prior helper effects and old RHS snapshot with no final store on failure; `.len()` remains a full read including N0.
2. T/N identity holds at construction, all whole transfers, incoming/outgoing calls and indexing; malformed/wrong-type/alias/permission/raw failures remain distinct from successful native execution. Reuse existing verifier/reference models where applicable; invalid raw inputs never enter consumers.
3. All whole-array destination paths write their complete logical extent. Empty i32 reserves and writes four zero bytes; empty bool/unit one; nonempty unit every cell zero. Nonempty bool i1 storage does not establish full-byte padding canon. Reviewer-owned physical tests poison complete destination and adjacent guards before unchanged production operations, compare every initialized byte afterwards, retain uninstrumented IR, prove observed operation bodies unchanged, and fail against narrow one-byte empty-i32 mutants. Logical read results alone are insufficient.
4. Boolean phi predecessor is actual final success label in arithmetic->bounds, bounds->arithmetic, repeated bounds, nonsplitting suffix, no split, and guarded terminator cases. A phi selects slot pointers before the chosen load; untaken uninitialized slot is never loaded eagerly.
5. Diagnostic key is full FailureKind(Fuel/Overflow/Bounds), file/start/end. Preserve first encounter IDs and exact inherited bytes/IR. Invalid supplied-map spans retain keys but are filtered before any lookup or source walk. Valid alternate maps preserve old rendering. Shared formatter body/escaping preserves Unicode, LF, CRLF, tabs, controls, paths, EOF and filtered primary behavior without SourceFile::location fallback. The independent coordinate oracle computes prefix-based expected coordinates only in tests.
6. Monotonic coordinate preflight independently computes checked H=sum requested valid maxima from actual caller SourceMap bytes; the sweep consumes each file prefix once. Row visits, filtering/H pass, source bytes/scalars and sorting comparisons are separate inert counts. Same-start/different-end and long increasing-start families exercise O(H+U); private callers may exceed public source envelope.
7. Actual row sizes, live requested vector lengths/capacities, plan/admission buffers and reservation lifetimes must support K<=204097 and proposed 26,620,032-byte conservative combined peak under unchanged 32MiB cap. Dedup retains capacity-K accounting. All new reservation failures and precedence tested; all caller-owned raw/SourceMap/observer bytes and allocator/RSS exclusions stated. No unlisted retained or temporary vector allowed.
8. LLVM counting is actual emitter with no text allocation and stops inside every scalar/sentinel/diagnostic escaping loop. Checked byte-limit+1 work limit adds no valid-input denial. Count/render byte and charged-work equality; finite raw-site T preflight does not expand suffix. Lowered caps exercise early abort and exact/one-under admission without huge output.
9. Preserve old record/scalar IR, admission, costs, diagnostic ID order and origin precedence. Any necessary correction requires explicit reviewed rationale. Source rejection and verifier-seal compile-fail controls remain distinct evidence.

## Finite independent model and planned cases

`expected-v1.json` fixes 90 deduplicated scalar/type/N0..4/index tuples, 180 separate read/write executions, and 15 length expectations. Payload seeds distinguish i32 cells and bool parity. Add maximum-width N1024 T3 with six extrema/boundary indices, without 1024 local slots. Nine destination paths are named independently. The six phi predecessor families use actual source-free ELF plus structural assertions. Resource constants are independently calculated and remain hypotheses until actual-crate size/lifetime evidence.

Small fuel/effect schedules will be frozen with raw fixtures before observing candidate results, using only the accepted charge table and abstract owner/scalar sequences. Capability and malformed tests retain inherited corpus identity and modify one fact at a time. No broad redundant Cartesian multiplication is claimed.

## Build and artifact evidence

Producer checkout is read-only to reviewer. No heavy build until API review and coordinator slot. Use Rust1.99.0/LLVM19.1.7 from trusted env, Linux x86_64, jobs2/incremental0, dedicated external target. Fresh independent source archive is immutable; manifest every original file and exact source/tree hash, then append reviewer-only cfg(test) source-bound marker in an observer copy. Verify test inventory and binary hash before execution. Capture full commands, status, test counts, compiler/tool hashes, source hashes and preserved ELF/IR. Retain failed attempts and fixture corrections; integrated reviewer artifacts must be copied unchanged except reviewer-owned mechanical repair. Distinguish bounded checkpoint pass from final native/integration acceptance.
